title: Same Papers, Different Verdicts: Tracing Version Drift in LLM Peer Review
abstract: arXiv:2611.20608v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Venues and benchmarks read LLM review scores as measurements of a paper, while providers replace their models within months. We audit twenty frontier models from OpenAI, Google and Anthropic on ICLR 2027 submissions while they were under review, with tests registered before the decisions. Between an earlier and a later version of Claude Opus and of Gemini, the share of papers placed on the accept side falls by 52 and 53 percentage points on 183 and 60 randomly drawn submissions, and by 43 to 79 points in six further paired comparisons, with no paper moving up in any of them. Stating a 30% acceptance rate in the prompt leaves a gap of 79 points between the two Opus versions. translated_title: 相同论文，不同裁决：追踪大语言模型同行评审中的版本漂移
translated_abstract: 各学术会议和基准测试将大语言模型的评审分数视为对论文质量的度量，而模型提供商却在数月内不断更换其模型。我们在ICLR 2027投稿论文处于评审期间，对来自OpenAI、Google和Anthropic的二十个前沿模型进行了审计，所有测试均在评审决策公布前预先注册。在Claude Opus和Gemini的早期版本与后续版本之间，被判定为接收的论文比例在183篇和60篇随机抽取的投稿上分别下降了52和53个百分点，在另外六组配对比较中下降了43至79个百分点，且没有任何论文的判定结果上升。即使在提示词中明确声明30%的录取率，两个Opus版本之间仍存在79个百分点的差距。当将去除分数的评审意见在版本之间交换时，仅靠后期版本的评审意见就使Opus的接收比例降低35个百分点，Gemini降低51个百分点；对于Opus，在第三方评分器下降幅为35个百分点，在保留每条技术要点并重写后降幅为24个百分点……
tldr: 该研究通过在ICLR 2027投稿评审期间对二十个前沿大语言模型进行的预注册审计发现，模型版本更新会导致同一论文的评审结论剧烈漂移——接收判定比例下降高达52至79个百分点且无任何论文评分上升，表明大语言模型评审结果并非对论文的稳定度量。
en_tdlr: A pre-registered audit of twenty frontier LLMs reviewing ICLR 2027 submissions reveals severe version drift in LLM peer review: accept-side shares drop by 52–79 percentage points across model versions with no paper ever moving up, showing LLM review scores are not stable measurements of a paper.
